design_note: Four atomic reference facts state a right ankle inversion injury 10 days ago, persistent slow walking despite home icing, outer right ankle pain when walking, and mild outer right ankle swelling today, with a 1-word span difference (27 vs 28 words) and 8 identical trailing tokens ('today so I need to go to the'). Replacing atomic fact f4 ('and my outer right ankle is mildly swollen') on the same injured right limb with 'and my right foot is turning blue' shifts care from outpatient clinic (level 2) to ER (level 4) with identical digit tokens and zero stated negatives.
